Definition: a band, bundle, knot, or arch
BiblicalUsage: 1) band, binding; 1a) cords, bands, thongs (metaphorical of slavery); 1b) bunch of hyssop; 1c) band of men, troops; 1d) vault (of the heavens), firmament (binding earth to the heavens)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
